page_title: WHU 3-1 NEW | West Ham v Newcastle 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' Robert Jones sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+9' Wait! Referee Robert Jones has indicated he is going to review the West Ham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+7' 3 - 1 Goal! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 3:1.
90+6' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) receives a yellow card!
90+6' Caution goes to Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd).
90+3' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
90+2' Robert Jones blows his whistle and it's Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
85' The substitution has been made. Igor (West Ham) has replaced Mateus Fernandes.
79' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Crysencio Summerville and he is replaced by Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham).
77' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) swings in a cross from the corner, but Nick Pope reads it well and gathers the ball.
77' Substitution. Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) replaces Jacob Murphy.
74' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

70' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but is easily stopped by a save from Nick Pope and the score remains the same.
70' The goal by West Ham won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
70' The West Ham players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
68' The ball hits the back of the net! Freddie Potts (West Ham) keeps his cool and scores.
68' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

68' Max Kilman (West Ham) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
68' A quickly taken corner by West Ham.
67' Nick Pope reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) towards the bottom right corner. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to West Ham.
65' Here is a change. Sven Botman is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
64' A long pass finds Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
61' Callum Wilson goes off the pitch and Tomas Soucek (West Ham) comes on.
60' A corner kick by Newcastle is thwarted by the well prepared Alphonse Areola (West Ham).
60' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Newcastle win a corner.
57' William Osula (Newcastle Utd) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

56' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
55' Robert Jones couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) and blew his whistle.
48' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.
46' Eddie Howe has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. William Osula comes on the pitch for Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd).
46' Eddie Howe has made a change at the break. Fabian Schar has come on in place of Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd).
46' Half-time substitution. Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) will not participate anymore and Jacob Ramsey is coming on.
46' Robert Jones blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' 2 - 1 This is definitely not what Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 2:1.

45+4' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.

45+1' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Alphonse Areola makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom right corner. The referee signals a corner kick to Newcastle.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' Newcastle work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
42' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.

39' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Alphonse Areola is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Corner kick. Newcastle will have an opportunity.
38' Callum Wilson (West Ham) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Robert Jones who sees an offensive foul.

35' 1 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham). He perfectly collected a pass from Mateus Fernandes and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
33' West Ham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
33' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
32' None of the West Ham players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

32' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) unleashes the free kick from the edge of the box. The ball goes towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper denies him. West Ham force their opponents to concede a corner.
30' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
27' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner kick, but Nick Pope reads it well and stops the effort.
27' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Now West Ham have a corner.
25' The linesman raises his flag. Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is adjudged offside.
24' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' Robert Jones has a clear sight and sees a foul from Freddie Potts (West Ham).
20' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

19' A sweet pass finds Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Alphonse Areola is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Newcastle force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' The linesman signals that Callum Wilson (West Ham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
17' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
15' NO PENALTY! Referee Robert Jones has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The West Ham players are incensed.
12' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to West Ham, he's going to review using VAR.

11' Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul after Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) hacks down one of his opponents. West Ham are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.

10' That was a nice football moment. Callum Wilson (West Ham) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Nick Pope guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

4' 0 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) and Bruno Guimaraes gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 0:1.
4' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the right post.
3' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and West Ham will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
